title: Alpine Forest
dek: Cold woodland east of the Old Earth Hills, explored for game and materials with danger that persists between visits.
body:
Beyond the Old Earth Hills to the east, the Alpine Forest opens into cold terrain, rocky heights and dense woodland. It offers game, timber and metal alongside predators and stretches of quiet wilderness. No single expedition clears its dangers or turns every resource discovery into an owned holding.

Scene evidence: 1.

Pappy and Iridos explore together

In the September 2025 exchanges, Pappy comes wrapped in a bearskin cloak, reminded of his mother’s stories of a frozen forest. Iridos approaches cautiously. They agree to make notes and retreat from danger they cannot handle; five enormous wolves then leap down from a rocky crag. Their curiosity brings them into real danger, without an assignment or a promised reward.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

October 2025 · Severina and Cerwin

An expedition with Cerwin Rayolet turns fatal when five alpine wolves surround Severina. After she falls, a wolf bites her again; the narrator records her last breath. Cerwin kills the remaining threat and takes her body back toward Pristinia.

Severina is active in later records, including the 2026 survey and Pristinia’s defenses. The forest exchange does not explain how she returns, so her death here is not presented as her final fate.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

The copper mine becomes a remembered place

Ruben identifies an abandoned copper mine in November 2025. In February 2026 he finds it again and explicitly recognizes it as the mine he had described before. That repeated recognition supports a known resource site rather than a fresh discovery on every visit. It does not establish surveyed coordinates, ownership, a developed mine or a measured yield.

Scene evidence: 1, 2.

A landscape larger than its visitors

The forest’s original description includes alpine wolves, elk, old trees, a bear cave and a sleeping giant owl. It also places the giant Ulmorodon grazing at the tops of pine trees. That establishes the scale of the regional description; it does not establish the creature’s origin, a bond with an adventurer or a successful hunt.

Scene evidence: 1.
